question: 2026年2月华东的GMV相比上个月变化的原因是什么？请从一级类目、平台和店铺维度拆解

keys.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' THEN o.total_amount + o.freight_amount END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-02-01' THEN o.total_amount + o.freight_amount END) - 1 FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东'
